#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=Cu-case-7.in
#SBATCH --time=8:00:00
#SBATCH --nodes=16
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=32
#SBATCH --exclusive
#SBATCH --output=%x.o%j
#
# The PBS directive '-j oe' (join stdout and stderr) is the default
# behavior in Slurm. The specific output file naming from the original script
# ($PBS_JOBNAME.o$JOB_NUM) is replicated using the --output flag.
#
# The following PBS directive was not translated:
# #PBS -ko: Keep output on the execution host.
# In a typical Slurm setup with a shared filesystem, output files are written
# directly to the final destination, so this option is not needed.
# There are no performance implications.
#

# Print the node list for debugging purposes
echo "Running on the following nodes:"
scontrol show hostnames $SLURM_NODELIST

source /etc/profile.d/modules.sh
module load use.projects
module load use.easybuild
module load lammps/28Jun14-gmvolf-3.5.0
#
echo ""
echo ""
# The following message is preserved from the original PBS script
echo "The following PBS extra args (PBS_EXTRA_ARGS) will be used: -P ldrd"
echo "The following lammps extra args (LAMMPS_EXTRA_ARGS) will be used: "

# Change to the submission directory (this is default Slurm behavior, but explicit is safe)
cd $SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR

# The original script had complex logic to move output files from $HOME.
# This is handled natively by Slurm's --output directive and is not needed.

# Launch the parallel job using srun, the native Slurm job launcher.
srun /home/shormich/projects/fission/lammps/src/lammps-16Feb16/src/lammps -in $SLURM_JOB_NAME

inputs.script:
#!/bin/bash
#PBS -N Cu-case-7.in
#PBS -j oe
#PBS -ko
#PBS -l walltime=8:00:00
#PBS -l select=16:ncpus=32:mpiprocs=32
#PBS -l place=excl
#
#
cat $PBS_NODEFILE
source /etc/profile.d/modules.sh
module load use.projects
module load use.easybuild
module load lammps/28Jun14-gmvolf-3.5.0
#
echo ""
echo ""
echo "The following PBS extra args (PBS_EXTRA_ARGS) will be used: -P ldrd"
echo "The following lammps extra args (LAMMPS_EXTRA_ARGS) will be used: "
NPROCS=`cat $PBS_NODEFILE | wc -l`
cd $PBS_O_WORKDIR
JOB_NUM=${PBS_JOBID%\.*}
if [ $PBS_O_WORKDIR != $HOME ]
then
ln -s $HOME/$PBS_JOBNAME.o$JOB_NUM $PBS_JOBNAME.o$JOB_NUM
fi
#
mpirun -genvlist PATH,LD_LIBRARY_PATH /home/shormich/projects/fission/lammps/src/lammps-16Feb16/src/lammps  -in $PBS_JOBNAME 
#
if [ $PBS_O_WORKDIR != $HOME ]
then
rm $PBS_JOBNAME.o$JOB_NUM
mv $HOME/$PBS_JOBNAME.o$JOB_NUM $PBS_JOBNAME.o$JOB_NUM
fi
